Synopsis:
    The Indian rupee hit a two-month high driven by $136.4B in inflows boosting RBI reserves to record levels. Offsetting tailwinds include rising crude oil prices from renewed US-Iran conflict and a stronger dollar supported by hawkish Fed rate hike expectations. The RBI's expanding forward book limits rupee upside despite the reserve buffer. India's BoP is projected to swing to a ~$66B surplus this fiscal year.
